question: GOLD Stage II COPD is defined by a post-bronchodilator FEV₁/FVC ratio < 0.70 and FEV₁ 50–79% of predicted.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is actually correct. GOLD Stage II = FEV₁/FVC <0.70 + FEV₁ 50–79% predicted. Review the four GOLD stages.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. GOLD staging: Stage I ≥80%, Stage II 50–79%, Stage III 30–49%, Stage IV <30% — all with FEV₁/FVC <0.70 post-bronchodilator.
